leads.title: Myanmar Penal Code 1861, Section 377
leads.documents: Criminalization of same-sex sexual acts regardless of consent or privacy, punishable by up to 10 years imprisonment; also covers heterosexual anal intercourse and oral sex; basis for sodomy arrests including Nov 2018 arrest
leads.detail: Cited as 'section 377 of Myanmar's Penal Code 1861, enacted in 1886' with penalties described as 'not less than 2 years, but may extend to 10 years' and fine 'not less than four hundred rupees but may extend to one thousand rupees'; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Myanmar Police Act 1945, Section 35(c) - 'shadow law' / 'darkness law'
leads.documents: Allows police to detain anyone behaving suspiciously after sunset; described as routinely used to target LGBTQ people and transgender people for harassment, sexual assault and extortion
leads.detail: Cited with Burmese title '1945 ခုနှစ်၊ ရဲအက်ဥပဒေ'; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Emergency Provisions Act, Section 5(j)
leads.documents: Prohibits anything that might negatively affect morality of individual, society or public; listed as additional provision usable against LGBTQ people
leads.detail: Cited with Burmese 'အရေးပေါ်စီမံမှုအက်ဥပဒေ'; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Myanmar Penal Code Sections 269, 270, 290, 292, 293, 294, 372, 469
leads.documents: Other provisions usable against LGBTQ people: negligent spread of STDs, public nuisance, obscenity, underage prostitution/illicit sexual relations, marriage ceremony without legal marriage
leads.detail: Listed in Legality section with fines and descriptions; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Myanmar Child Rights Law (2019)
leads.documents: Includes non-discrimination clause referencing sexual orientation but applies only to children and lacks enforcement mechanisms; cited to show no enforceable protections
leads.detail: Mentioned in Discrimination protections section; no URL visible in text

leads.title: MRTV Broadcasting Guidelines (2020)
leads.documents: Encourage avoiding discriminatory media portrayals; described as non-binding with no legal penalties
leads.detail: Mentioned in Discrimination protections section; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Gender Policy on Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights (2022)
leads.documents: Includes LGBTQ individuals as vulnerable group in healthcare delivery context; described as planning document, not enforceable law
leads.detail: Mentioned in Discrimination protections section; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Myanmar National Human Rights Commission - investigation into Kyaw Zin Win death
leads.documents: Separate institutional investigation into June 2019 suicide of gay librarian at Myanmar Imperial University in Yangon after harassment/bullying; call for anti-discrimination provisions; university suspended three staff
leads.detail: Cited with Burmese 'မြန်မာနိုင်ငံ အမျိုးသားလူ့အခွင့်အရေး ကော်မရှင်'; notes 600+ attended funeral with rainbow flag; no URL visible in text

leads.title: PinkNews - reporting on Kyaw Zin Win case
leads.documents: Documents funeral coverage and that case 'prompted a national conversation' on LGBT issues in Myanmar
leads.detail: Cited in text as 'PinkNews reported'; no URL visible in text

leads.title: All Burma Students' Democratic Front 2001 vote / Campaign for Lesbigay Rights in Burma
leads.documents: Exile group vote in 2001 to repeal Section 377, seen as victory by Committee for Lesbigay Rights in Burma but considered unlikely given political climate
leads.detail: Mentioned in Legality section; no URL visible in text
